landing.title: Genesy
landing.description: Genesy records the harvest, follows the batch, prints a passport for every jar and pays the farmer when it sells.

hero.tag: Farm to kitchen, in the open
hero.title: Every jar has a story. Every farmer gets their share.
hero.lead: Genesy records the harvest, follows the batch, prints a passport for every jar and pays the farmer when it sells. One system, from the field to the till.
hero.scene: Illustration: a beehive in hills, a dotted route leading to a honey jar

journey.title: Watch one jar travel — and the money travel back.

hive.title: Hive
hive.text: Bees make the honey. The farmer records each hive.

harvest.title: Harvest
harvest.text: Every harvest is logged: who, where, how much.

passport.title: Passport
passport.text: Packed into a batch; every jar gets a QR passport.

scan.title: Scan
scan.text: A buyer scans the jar and reads its story.

sold.title: Sold
sold.text: Online or at the till, from one stock list.

paid.title: Paid back
paid.text: The farmer’s share flows back into their passbook.

who.title: Built for the people along the route.

programmes.title: Farmer programmes & cooperatives
programmes.text: Know every farmer and every harvest, and show that pay is fair.
programmes.p1: Field records that work without signal
programmes.p2: Swahili and English on every screen
programmes.p3: Each farmer sees their own passbook

brands.title: Brands & shops
brands.text: Sell online and in store with proof on every jar.
brands.p1: Web shop and till share one stock
brands.p2: A passport QR for each batch
brands.p3: From jar back to harvest in seconds

buyers.title: Buyers
buyers.text: Holding one of our jars? Point your phone camera at its QR code.
buyers.p1: Where and when it was harvested

passport.title: Scan the jar. Read its whole story.
passport.lead: Every batch has its own page. No app to install — the phone camera is enough.

c1.title: Where it comes from
c1.text: Region, harvest month, how many beekeepers.

c3.title: Who got paid
c3.text: Farmers are credited at every sale.

passport.phone: Example passport on a phone (made-up data)

promise.title: Plain rules the system keeps for you.

private.title: Your account is private
private.text: Each organisation sees only its own farmers, stock and sales.

consent.title: Sharing needs consent
consent.text: Data moves to a partner only through a link the farmer agreed to.

exact.title: Money is exact
exact.text: Counted to the cent. Passbook lines stay as they were written.

contact.title: Grow, pack or sell something worth tracing? Let’s talk.
contact.note: English, Dutch or Swahili. We reply within two working days.
